field_semantics.main_entrants: Reported/cross-checked count of occupied Main entrant positions, not bracket capacity; still historical evidence, not a certified sporting profile.
field_semantics.main_bracket_slots: Physical knockout bracket positions, including BYEs; null for round-robin group format.
field_semantics.main_byes: Unoccupied knockout bracket positions; null for group format.
field_semantics.reported_main_qualifiers: Reported Q count in Main draw or secondary summary; not a certified number of reserved qualification feeder places.
field_semantics.reported_main_wild_cards: Reported WC count in Main draw or secondary summary; not a certified allocation policy.
field_semantics.observed_lucky_losers: Observed replacement labels, not additional guaranteed qualification places.
field_semantics.qualification_size_secondary: Reported Q draw size; does not establish actual participants, sections, byes or dates.
field_semantics.entry_policy: Certified reserved places and replacement policy are independent of observed entry labels; null until evidenced.
